::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 16th 1880  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS Harry Ransom Humanities Research Center, University of Texas. C. R. Coleridge Collection.
:::

My dear Miss [name erased]

I am so sorry, but I am going to London on Monday for the [G F S](organizations/other_23.qmd) affairs, and I do not come home till Saturday. If you are going out on an expedition could you not take me on your way back?  I come home on the 27th, and on any day but the 29th shall be at home. At least I have promised to take [my niece](people/person_1613.qmd) in one day of the Assize week to see [Lord Coleridge](people/person_343.qmd) in court, and I am not quite sure which that will be

Yours sincerely
CM Yonge
